title: Unfolding a gate
statement: Let $g$ be a gate, let $t$ assign a Boolean circuit tree to each natural-numbered vertex and polarity, and let $p$ be a polarity. An AND gate unfolds to a node with polarity $p$ whose children are the trees assigned by $t$ to its argument vertices with polarity $p$; an OR gate unfolds to a node with polarity opposite to $p$ and those same child assignments. A NOT gate unfolds to the tree assigned to the first argument, or to vertex $0$ if there is no argument, with polarity opposite to $p$.
hypotheses_covered: A natural number $n$ of input variables
A function assigning a circuit tree to each vertex and polarity
